ops.text: Section 10.14 Insurance. The Servicer will maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000.

input.comment: [Playbook] We add a short insurance covenant in Article X because the Agreement has none, even though the Servicer handles Obligor account and payment data. This sits at our fallback position (E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of $2,000,000); we can discuss our preferred limits if you prefer a fuller programme.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.14 requiring Servicer E&O insurance of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy insurance of $2,000,000.
